grade.first_issue: No decisive defect; none of Rules A–F imposes a cap.
grade.summary: The submission correctly proves that the solutions are exactly f(x)=x+c for constants c≥0. It verifies these functions, derives nonnegativity and orbit invariance of g=f−id, proves all positive values of g coincide using asymptotically close forward orbits, and excludes coexistence of defect values 0 and c by connectedness.
strengths: The substitution x=f(y) correctly yields the linear behavior of every forward orbit and hence g≥0.
The limiting argument comparing two positive defect values is valid and proves their equality.
The mixed-value case is correctly ruled out by showing the two level sets are relatively open.
The converse follows immediately and correctly from AM–GM and RMS–AM.

errors.description: When asserting I_y⊆A and J_x⊆B, the intervals should formally be intersected with (0,∞); the surrounding context makes the intended relative-domain statement clear and the openness argument remains valid.
